i.norm: Builds a {@link SimpleBloomFilter} of the given shape whose bits are populated from the hasher. @param shape the shape of the filter. @param hasher the hasher used to set the filter's bits. @return the populated filter.

Verifies that {@code asBitMapArray()} returns one long per 64 bits of the shape, with the bits set by the hasher reported in the correct word.

The shape spans 72 bits, so the result holds two longs. The hasher sets bit 63 (the most significant bit of word 0) and bit 64 (the least significant bit of word 1).
